panel.description: Generate a foreground depth mask for each wallpaper so desktop widgets can pass behind nearby scenery.

setup.disclosure: Setup creates a private Python environment and downloads the 99 MB Apache-2.0 Depth Anything V2 Small model from Hugging Face. No wallpaper is uploaded.
setup.offline: Shell offline mode blocks setup downloads.

service.busy: Wait for the current operation to finish.
service.invalid_result: The depth helper returned an invalid result.
service.offline: Disable shell offline mode before setup.
service.setup_missing: The model and runtime are not installed.
service.setup_running: Installing the runtime and downloading the 99 MB model.
service.start_helper_failed: Could not start the depth helper.

auto_generate.description: Regenerate the output mask when its wallpaper or mask parameters change.
auto_generate.label: Generate automatically

feather.description: Width of the soft transition around the depth threshold.
feather.label: Edge feather

threshold.description: Normalized depth above which the wallpaper erases desktop widgets. Lower values place more of the scene in front.
threshold.label: Foreground threshold
